rules.respecScope: attributes and earned class talents only

classes.name: Warlord
classes.playstyle: Command the fight through positioning, weapon pressure and rally orders.

classTrait.name: Momentum
classTrait.mechanic: Gain momentum by completing ordered advances or counters; spend it on a committed command.

classes.equipmentIdentity: swords, axes, polearms; medium or heavy armor

classes.name: Oathwarden
classes.playstyle: Protect a chosen space and turn a successful defense into a counterattack.

classTrait.name: Oath marks
classTrait.mechanic: Sworn ground rewards guarding and measured retaliation; abandoning it gives up the stored benefit.

classes.equipmentIdentity: swords, maces; medium or heavy armor

classes.name: Ranger
classes.playstyle: Choose a quarry, shape its approach and strike from a prepared angle.

classTrait.name: Quarry
classTrait.mechanic: Tracking an actual target builds one bounded opening; changing quarry loses the old opening.

classes.equipmentIdentity: bows, spears, paired blades; light or medium armor

classes.name: Druid
classes.playstyle: Use living ground, roots and seasonal exchanges to change the battlefield.

classTrait.name: Growth
classTrait.mechanic: Cultivate visible patches, then consume their growth for control or recovery.

classes.equipmentIdentity: staves, sickles; light armor

classes.name: Spellblade
classes.playstyle: Weave close weapon strikes with brief storm charges and precise repositioning.

classTrait.name: Charge
classTrait.mechanic: A completed weapon pattern prepares a charge; spend it on one named arcane follow-up.

classes.equipmentIdentity: swords, spears; light or medium armor

classes.name: Stormcaller
classes.playstyle: Read a visible forecast and place wind, rain and lightning deliberately.

classTrait.name: Pressure
classTrait.mechanic: Wind and rain spells build a forecast; discharge it along telegraphed storm lanes.

classes.equipmentIdentity: staves, rods; light armor

classes.name: Death Knight
classes.playstyle: Bind hostile pressure into finite debt and answer it through weapon combat.

classTrait.name: Debt
classTrait.mechanic: Intercept real harm to bank a capped counter; debt expires and cannot be farmed on allies.

classes.equipmentIdentity: swords, axes; heavy armor

classes.name: Necromancer
classes.playstyle: Spend battlefield remains to command short-lived servants, curses and bone cover.

classTrait.name: Remains
classTrait.mechanic: Finite eligible remains power temporary summons; summoned deaths never produce more remains.

classes.equipmentIdentity: staves, ritual blades; light armor

classes.name: Berserker
classes.playstyle: Commit to close pursuit, build fury and choose when to release or restrain it.

classTrait.name: Fury
classTrait.mechanic: Committed strikes build fury; spending it forces a readable recovery instead of endless chaining.

classes.equipmentIdentity: axes, greatswords, claws; light or medium armor

classes.name: Moon Witch
classes.playstyle: Use lunar marks, howls and predatory bargains to manipulate pursuit.

classTrait.name: Moon phases
classTrait.mechanic: A visible sequence alternates pursuit and restraint; each phase offers a different payoff.

classes.equipmentIdentity: staves, ritual blades; light armor

classes.name: Reaver
classes.playstyle: Break a defended position with heavy blows and carefully timed intimidation.

classTrait.name: Impact
classTrait.mechanic: Committed heavy attacks build fracture on a target; overcommitting leaves a long punishable recovery.

classes.equipmentIdentity: axes, hammers, greatswords; heavy armor

classes.name: Pyromancer
classes.playstyle: Lay fire, manage its spread and consume heat for a controlled release.

classTrait.name: Heat
classTrait.mechanic: Casting builds heat; vent it deliberately or suffer a predictable reduction in casting efficiency.

classes.equipmentIdentity: staves, rods; light armor

classes.name: Wayfinder
classes.playstyle: Set routes and anchors that turn difficult ground into an advantage.

classTrait.name: Route marks
classTrait.mechanic: A few visible anchors enable repeatable movement tricks, with no teleportation through blocked ground.

classes.equipmentIdentity: spears, bows, swords; light or medium armor

classes.name: Tidebinder
classes.playstyle: Shape a finite supply of water into flow, mist and returning waves.

classTrait.name: Stored water
classTrait.mechanic: Move water between connected patches; strong effects dry their source instead of appearing endlessly.

classes.equipmentIdentity: staves, rods; light armor

classes.name: Marshal
classes.playstyle: Combine disciplined weapon combat with portable tools and explicit orders.

classTrait.name: Readiness
classTrait.mechanic: Preparing an order costs time now to improve one later action; only one preparation may be banked.

classes.equipmentIdentity: swords, polearms, crossbows; medium or heavy armor

classes.name: Runemage
classes.playstyle: Draw a small network of deliberate glyphs and trigger their interactions.

classTrait.name: Inscribed charges
classTrait.mechanic: Place a bounded number of visible runes; consume, reposition or combine them at real preparation cost.

classes.equipmentIdentity: staves, rune tools; light or medium armor

classes.name: Stoneguard
classes.playstyle: Brace at a chosen boundary and convert a heavy impact into a measured counter.

classTrait.name: Brace
classTrait.mechanic: A timed brace catches one valid impact; carrying it slows turning until the stored force is released.

classes.equipmentIdentity: hammers, axes, shields; heavy armor

classes.name: Earthshaper
classes.playstyle: Manipulate stone seams, resonance and temporary terrain without sealing every route.

classTrait.name: Resonance
classTrait.mechanic: Valid stone anchors carry finite pulses; every obstruction preserves a readable path around it.

classes.equipmentIdentity: staves, hammers; light or medium armor

classes.name: Thief
classes.playstyle: Infiltrate dangerous spaces, solve physical obstacles and use limited tools to secure optional treasure before escaping.

classTrait.name: Preparation
classTrait.mechanic: Reconnaissance identifies real locks, traps and pockets. Spend a bounded tool supply to create an opening; each marked container or enemy can yield its registered stolen item only once.

classes.equipmentIdentity: short blades, slings, light crossbows; light armor and tool belt
classes.combatIdentity: Distraction, control and escape; weaker sustained damage and no automatic boss execution.
classes.rewardRules: Theft uses registered one-time optional rewards. It cannot duplicate boss loot, invent unlimited money or satisfy a mandatory boss-clear objective.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.playstyle: Isolate a dangerous opponent, attack from an earned angle and spend a brief opening on precise melee pressure.

classTrait.name: Openings
classTrait.mechanic: A successful flank, interrupt or timed evasion opens one target. Spend that opening on a precise finisher; it expires on a target switch and cannot stack into an infinite stun.

classes.equipmentIdentity: paired daggers, short swords, hand crossbow; light or medium armor
classes.combatIdentity: Single-target burst, bounded poison and bleed pressure, interrupts; fragile when surrounded and weak against sustained frontal pressure.
classes.rewardRules: Earn ordinary combat rewards through the registered encounter ledger; precision does not manufacture extra loot or unlock Thief-only tools.
